page.overview:
Who is Barney the Dinosaur?

Barney the Dinosaur is a kids TV show character. He is a purple T-Rex with a green belly.

Homer Simpson watched Barney on television before the show was interrupted by Mr. Burns.

Howard Hawkley didn't care if Itchy was the biggest box-office star since the dinosaur.

He was used by the Movementarians to brainwash babies into following the Leader.
